create_image_list_from_tensors: create an ImageList by padding a list of tensors to the same size with a given pad_value and size_divisibility
build_image_list_from_tensor_and_sizes: build an ImageList from a padded tensor and a list of original image sizes as (h, w) tuples
get_image_list_length: get the number of images in an ImageList using __len__
get_image_list_item: access an individual image from an ImageList by index, returning it in its original size
move_image_list_to_device: move an ImageList tensor to a different device or dtype using the to method
